reviews.text: I’ve been using the Some By Mi AHA BHA PHA 30 Days Miracle AC SOS Kit and it’s a great starter set for acne-prone, oily, or combination skin. This 4-step kit includes a gentle acne-clearing foam, exfoliating toner, serum, and calming cream that work together to remove dead skin cells, unclog pores, and soothe irritation thanks to AHA, BHA, PHA, tea tree and centella extracts. Many users find their skin becomes smoother, clearer, and less oily with consistent use over a few weeks, and I personally like how it helps refine texture and reduce blemishes when applied regularly. Some people with sensitive skin recommend introducing each product slowly to avoid irritation at first, but overall this kit is gentle and effective for daily care.
reviews.zh: 我一直用緊 Some By Mi AHA BHA PHA 30 Days Miracle AC SOS Kit，對於易生暗瘡、出油或者混合性皮膚，呢套係一套好好嘅入門套裝。呢套 4 步嘅套裝包括一款溫和祛痘潔面泡沫、去角質爽膚水、精華同舒緩面霜，靠 AHA、BHA、PHA、茶樹同積雪草萃取，一齊去除死皮細胞、疏通毛孔，並舒緩刺激。好多用家都覺得，只要持續用幾個星期，皮膚會變得更滑、更清透、冇咁油；我個人就鍾意佢定期使用之後，幫手改善膚質同淡化瑕疵。有啲敏感皮膚嘅人建議先慢慢逐樣產品加入，以免初期刺激，但整體嚟講呢套產品溫和又有效，適合日常護理。

reviews.text:
I’m so happy I got this, I’ve been looking for a line that specifically treats acne, which is why I got this. It’s great to try all of these products before buying and I enjoyed all of them.

The cleanser - it was good, to be honest not the best anti acne cleanser, but still better than the super matcha pore care cleanser from this brand. It smells and somehow feels minty on the skin and stings the eye area, even though I don’t have sensitive skin or eyes, so be careful. 

The toner - good toner, helped reduce acne and redness, absorbs very nicely and I’ll probably buy a full size, maybe even the toner pads from this line.

The serum - I have very mixed feelings about this because it helped my acne so much, even just overnight but it’s a very oily serum. This is a serum facial oil hybrid and you can even see the separated oil, so shake before use. It didn’t contest my pores (I have oily skin that hates oils in moisturizers, especially facial oils) and made my face very glowy in a good way. The only problem is that I don’t love the way it feels on my face and I can’t use a lot or it will overwhelm my skin. I might buy the full size, but I’m not sure.

The cream - literally amazing, deals with breakouts overnight and is actually moisturizing and non-drying, unlike other anti-acne creams I’ve used before. The only problem is the packaging, which looks very similar to the mini cleanser, but the full sized version is in a pot, so there won’t be an issue. I will definitely buy the full version!

This is a great mini travel set to try, maybe a bit smaller than the usual trial kits, especially the serum, which is only 10ml, but I still 100% recommend this to people who struggle with acne and want to get rid of it without any extreme or harsh skincare.
reviews.zh:
好開心買咗呢套，我一直想搵一個專門針對暗瘡嘅系列，所以先買。買之前可以試晒所有產品，真係好好，我每款都好鍾意。

潔面產品——幾好，老實講唔係最好嘅祛痘潔面，但仍然比呢個品牌嘅 Super Matcha 毛孔護理潔面好。佢用落有薄荷嘅感覺，用喺皮膚上好似有啲清涼感，而且會刺激眼部，雖然我嘅皮膚同眼睛都唔敏感，所以要小心。

爽膚水——好好用，幫手減少暗瘡同紅位，吸收得好好，我可能會買大size，甚至係呢個系列嘅爽膚棉。

精華——我對呢款感受好矛盾，因為佢即使只係用咗一晚，都對我嘅暗瘡幫助好大，但係佢係一款好油嘅精華。呢款係精華同面油嘅混合體，你甚至可以睇到油同水分分開，所以用之前要搖一搖。佢冇令我毛孔阻塞（我係油性皮膚，唔鍾意面霜入面嘅油，尤其係面油），而且令我面好有光澤，呢個係好嘅方面。唯一問題係，我唔係好鍾意佢搽喺面上嘅感覺，而且我唔可以用太多，否則會令我皮膚負荷不了。我可能會買大size，但我未確定。

面霜——真係好正，一夜之間就可以對付爆痘，而且佢真係有保濕效果，唔會乾燥，唔似我之前用過嘅其他祛痘面霜。唯一問題係包裝，同迷你潔面產品好似，但全尺寸嗰款係罐裝，所以唔會有問題。我一定會買全尺寸嗰款！

呢套係一套好好嘅迷你旅行裝，可能比一般試用套裝細啲，特別係精華，只有 10ml，但我仍然 100% 推薦畀受暗瘡困擾、又想唔使用好激烈或者刺激嘅護膚品就去除暗瘡嘅人。

reviews.text: it is a great trial kits. I especially enjoy the pimple patches. It works wonders however, the trio combination. I feel like it should have more stronger moisturizer on top of it, but overall works great. I like the brand and it’s great to try the miniature not have to buy a full size to know if it’s really works for you or not. great
reviews.zh: 呢套試用裝好好。我特別鍾意痘痘貼。不過，呢三件產品嘅組合效果好神奇。我覺得應該再加一款保濕力更強嘅面霜蓋喺上面，但整體效果好好。我好鍾意呢個品牌，而且試用迷你裝好好，唔使買全尺寸，就可以知道係咪真係適合你。好啱。

reviews.text: It really is a good option for treating acne...it does a really awesome job and also it makes the skin glow. this set has everything skincare needs: a foam cleanser; a toner; a serum and a very light and refreshing cream. It is very good especially if you have periodical acne that comes and goes and again returns after a certain period....if you travel it is also very good.
reviews.zh: 佢真係一個治療暗瘡嘅好選擇……效果非常好，仲令皮膚有光澤。呢套包含咗護膚所需嘅一切：泡沫潔面、爽膚水、精華同一款非常輕盈清爽嘅面霜。特別係如果你嘅暗瘡週期性出現，有時消失、過一段時間又再出現，佢就非常好用……如果你外出旅行，佢都好好用。

reviews.text: I started this kit 3 days ago and saw there is no new acne on my face and the ones I already have now are starting to disappear. Usually when I use acne products it stings and hurts but this one doesn’t! it feels nice on my skin and does not make it dry. I will be conitinuing to use this product !!
reviews.zh: 我由3日前開始用呢套裝，見到面上冇新嘅暗瘡，而家已有嘅暗瘡都開始消失咗。通常我用暗瘡產品都會刺痛，但係呢款唔會！用起嚟皮膚感覺好舒服，亦唔會令皮膚乾燥。我會繼續用呢款產品！！

reviews.text: Another great kit from SOMEBYMI that didn’t disappoint me. I tried the yuja niacin one so I was really excited to try this one too. All I have to say is that I’m really impressed with how quickly my skin improved, my maskne completely disappeared and my hyperpigmentation faded super quickly. I’ll definitely buy the products in full size.
reviews.zh: 又一套 SOMEBYMI 嘅好套裝，冇令我失望。我之前試過 Yuja Niacin 嗰套，所以今次都好期待試呢套。我只想講，我真係好驚訝我嘅皮膚改善得咁快，我嘅口罩痘（maskne）完全消失咗，色素沉澱亦都淡得好快。我一定會買全尺寸嘅產品。

reviews.zh: 我而家面上長緊痘。我先試吓 Some By Mi 嘅細裝，因為我聽人講呢款產品對暗瘡問題好有效。我好鍾意面部泡沫，只需要少少啫喱，就可以清走我面上嘅污垢。所有產品都冇香味。我唔使等好耐，所有產品就吸收晒落皮膚。
